jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.

  • Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.

  • Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

  • Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.

  • Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.

  • Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

  • Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.

  • Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

  • Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.


The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Partnerships Manager
jobs.excerpt: The companyIt's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market.
jobs.description:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We’re looking for a Partnership Manager - manda (iwoca's M&A Platform)

We're looking for someone to build the introducer network that brings business owners to manda, iwoca's M&A platform. Accountants, solicitors, wealth managers and brokers meet an owner who is thinking about retiring long before we do. Your job is to make sure that when they do they think of us, and that referring us is the easiest thing they do that day.

The role

Your mission is to build a referral channel that produces a steady flow of business owners who are genuinely ready to sell.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but the pool is finite. The professionals who already advise business owners are the most credible route to the ones we'd otherwise never reach, and right now we have no systematic way of working with them.

You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up.

It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses.

Key responsibilities include:

Build the introducer network

  • Find and win the firms worth working with: accountancy practices, corporate finance boutiques, solicitors, wealth managers and business transfer agents. Work out which kinds of firm actually refer, and concentrate there.

  • Do the outbound yourself. Identify the firm, get the meeting, make the case, and follow up until something happens.

  • Design what we offer them: how a referral is made, what the partner gets, what we commit to in return, and how we keep them informed once their client is with us.

Make referrals actually arrive

  • A signed partnership is worth nothing until a referral comes through. You'll own the ongoing relationship work that turns agreements into a flow: regular contact, keeping manda front of mind, briefing partner teams, and being the person they call.

  • Track referral volume and quality by partner, and be honest about which relationships aren't working so we can stop spending time on them.

Make the channel scale

  • Judge every partnership by whether it adds referrals without adding work. A relationship that only produces when you're in the room isn't a channel yet.

  • Work out which partner technology is worth plugging into: the practice management and accounting software advisers already work in, tracked referral links and partner portals, and integrations that let a firm refer a client without leaving their own tools. You won't build these yourself, but you'll identify them, make the commercial case, and scope them with our Product Builder.

  • Look for partners who can bring a book rather than one client at a time. One firm with hundreds of owner-managed clients is worth more to us than ten firms with five, if we can find a way to surface the right candidates across the whole book.

Work iwoca's existing network

  • iwoca already has a broker network and a partnerships function with relationships across the SME economy. Working out where manda fits into those relationships is far faster than starting cold, and it's the first place to look.

Events and community

  • Build a focused programme of events worth attending and, where it makes sense, running our own: succession and exit planning, accountancy and adviser events, industry gatherings, and business owner peer communities.

  • Judge them on referrals rather than attendance, and stop going to the ones that don't produce. Events are how you find and land partners, not how the channel scales.

Prove the channel pays

  • Establish what a referral actually costs us once your time, any partner incentives and events are counted, and how many convert into a signed mandate. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in partnerships, channel or business development, ideally B2B, where you built or substantially grew a referral channel rather than inheriting one that already worked.

  • You've done the full cycle yourself: identified the target firms, got the meetings, agreed the terms, and then managed the relationship afterwards.

  • A background in M&A, marketplaces, business broking or business transfer.

  • You understand that the work starts after the agreement is signed, and you have the discipline to keep a channel warm over months rather than weeks.

  • Numerate and honest about performance. You track referrals by partner, you know which relationships are producing, and you say so when one isn't.

  • You think in systems as well as relationships. You can tell the difference between a partnership that scales and one that only works while you're pushing it, and you'd rather replace your own manual work with an integration than defend it.

  • Comfortable specifying technology without building it. You can look at a partner's tools and our product, work out what would make us the path of least resistance, and scope it clearly enough for a product team to build.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team to delegate to: you'll build the target list, send the emails, run the meetings and keep the CRM straight yourself.

  • A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture.

Bonus:

  • Experience with accountancy, legal or wealth management channels specifically.

  • Experience running an event programme with commercial targets attached to it.

  • Familiarity with the UK succession and exit planning landscape.

  • Comfortable treating a CRM as a discipline rather than an afterthought, ideally HubSpot.

  • You've shipped a partner integration, an embedded referral flow or a software marketplace listing, or worked closely with a product team on one.

  • Familiar with the software UK accountancy practices and advisers actually work in, such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, IRIS or Dext.

The salary

We expect to pay £55,000–£80,000 and an annual performance based bonus for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation Range: £55K - £80K

Our platform combines AI-powered tools and practical career solutions to help job seekers create stronger applications, improve their professional profiles, and navigate their job search with greater confidence.

We are growing our team and are looking for an organized and people-focused People Operations Coordinator to support our employees and help keep day-to-day people processes running smoothly.

About the Role

As a People Operations Coordinator, you will support a range of employee-related activities, including onboarding, HR administration, internal communication, employee records, and day-to-day People Operations processes.

You will work closely with employees, managers, and the People team to help create a positive employee experience and ensure that important HR processes are handled accurately and efficiently.

This is a great opportunity for someone interested in HR, People Operations, or employee experience who wants to build practical experience in a growing technology company.

Responsibilities

  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding processes and ensure required information is completed.

  • Maintain accurate employee records, documents, and HR information.

  • Assist employees with routine HR and People Operations questions.

  • Coordinate internal People-related communications, meetings, and activities.

  • Support the administration of company policies, procedures, and employee programs.

  • Help organize employee engagement activities and internal initiatives.

  • Assist with improving People Operations processes and documentation.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication.

  • High attention to detail and ability to handle confidential information responsibly.

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, documents, and online HR tools.

jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyTurning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category — the marketplace for future customers.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category — the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We are the #1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we are accelerating.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Outbound Calling Officer to proactively contact property owners, buyers, sellers, investors, landlords, and tenants, and turn those conversations into qualified opportunities.

This role is not about "making calls." It is about disciplined outbound prospecting, sharp qualification, accurate CRM documentation, and timely follow-up — at high volume, without losing quality. The core performance standard is a minimum of 300 outbound call attempts per working day.

Requirements

  • High school / intermediate qualification, bachelor's degree, or equivalent education

  • 2-3 years of experience in outbound calling, telesales, telemarketing, customer service, lead generation, or appointment setting

  • Neutral US accent and confident, professional phone communication with US-based leads

  • Experience in real estate, property acquisition, brokerage, mortgage, or investor lead generation is highly desirable

  • Excellent verbal communication, active listening, questioning, and objection-handling skills

  • Comfort working with CRM systems, dialers, spreadsheets, and productivity tools

  • Ability to sustain high-volume outbound activity in a target-driven environment while maintaining accuracy and professionalism

What You'll Be Doing

Outbound prospecting & lead generation

  • Make a minimum of 300 outbound call attempts per working day using the company-approved dialer, CRM, and lead lists

  • Contact prospective buyers, sellers, property owners, investors, landlords, tenants, and other assigned real estate leads

  • Use approved scripts and talk tracks while keeping a natural, professional, consultative conversation style

  • Present the company and its services accurately, identify interest, and establish the appropriate next step

  • Generate qualified opportunities and transfer or assign them to the relevant Representative

  • Schedule property discussions and callbacks in line with campaign requirements

Lead qualification

  • Ask structured discovery questions to determine property ownership, location, property type, transaction objective, motivation, timeline, and decision-making authority

  • Capture pricing expectations, property condition, financing status, and preferred communication method where relevant

  • Distinguish qualified, nurture, callback, disqualified, and do-not-contact outcomes per the approved qualification framework

  • Escalate high-intent or time-sensitive opportunities promptly

CRM, follow-up & data management

  • Disposition 100% of completed call attempts and record accurate notes for meaningful conversations

  • Update contact, property, qualification, callback, and appointment information immediately after each interaction

  • Complete scheduled callbacks and follow-ups within the committed timeframe

  • Maintain confidentiality and protect customer, property, and company information

Communication & compliance

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, including when handling rejection, objections, or difficult conversations

  • Use approved objection-handling techniques without misleading, exaggerated, or unverified representations

  • Observe company policies, consent requirements, do-not-contact procedures, data privacy controls, and telemarketing rules for the relevant market

  • Participate in coaching, call calibration, quality reviews, and product training, and apply feedback consistently

How Performance Is Measured

Performance is assessed through a balanced combination of activity, quality, conversion, data discipline, and schedule compliance.

  • Daily outbound call attempts — minimum 300 per working day (30%)

  • Qualified leads generated — campaign target set by management (20%)

  • Quality Assurance score — 95% or above (15%)

  • CRM documentation accuracy — 95% or above (15%)

  • Schedule adherence & attendance — 95% or above (10%)

Volume benchmarks: 300+ calls per day, 1,500+ per week, approximately 6,000-6,600 per month.

Quality safeguard: the numerical dialing target does not, by itself, constitute satisfactory performance. Repeatedly abandoned, duplicated, improperly dispositioned, deliberately shortened, or otherwise non-compliant calls may be excluded from productive activity and may negatively affect performance evaluation.

This is not for you if

  • You treat the dial count as the goal instead of qualified opportunities

  • You cannot stay composed and productive through rejection and unanswered calls

  • You skip dispositions, notes, or scheduled callbacks

  • You need detailed instructions instead of taking ownership of your leads and follow-ups

  • You are not comfortable with a consistent 300-call daily standard

What We Expect From You (First 3 Months)

Week 1: Complete systems, script, compliance, objection-handling, and CRM training; demonstrate accurate call dispositions and supervised call readiness.

Weeks 2-4: Progress toward the 300-call daily standard while maintaining coaching responsiveness, data accuracy, and minimum quality requirements.

Day 30: Consistent activity, lead quality, QA results, CRM discipline, attendance, and measurable progress against campaign targets.

Day 60: Sustained performance, improved conversion effectiveness, reliable follow-up execution, and acceptable schedule adherence.

Day 90 (the bar): Successful completion of probation based on overall weighted KPI performance, conduct, attendance, and compliance with company standards.

Core Competencies

  • Communication — clear, confident, respectful, and persuasive telephone communication

  • Resilience — maintains composure and productivity despite rejection and objections

  • Accountability — owns assigned leads, follow-ups, data accuracy, and performance commitments

  • Attention to detail — records factual, complete, and usable CRM notes and dispositions

  • Coachability — receives feedback constructively and demonstrates measurable improvement

  • Integrity — represents company services accurately and complies with approved procedures

  • Time management — balances dialing volume, conversations, documentation, callbacks, and handoffs

  • Team collaboration — coordinates effectively with Sales, Acquisition, QA, and management teams

Working Conditions

  • Target-driven role requiring sustained telephone and computer usage throughout the working day

  • Working hours aligned with the targeted US market, and may include evening/night rotational shifts where operationally required

  • Calls will be monitored or recorded for quality assurance, training, compliance, and performance management in accordance with applicable policy and law

  • Performance targets may be adjusted where there are documented operational constraints such as insufficient lead inventory, system downtime, or approved training

What We Offer

  • Direct impact on pipeline and revenue from day one

  • Remote-first, flexible work environment

  • Competitive compensation

  • 3 weeks paid vacation + 5 paid sick days

  • Access to learning resources

  • AI-driven workflows and tooling

  • Fast-moving, execution-focused team

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

The Finance & Strategy team is an integral thought partner to Abridge’s cross-functional leadership. As a Finance & Strategy Lead, you’ll have a unique opportunity to play a pivotal part in our financial management and strategic planning process. The role will be integral in driving our company's financial health and visibility, and offers a chance to work at the cutting edge of AI technology and healthcare. We are seeking an individual who is passionate about their work, eager to engage in dynamic financial planning, and ready to contribute significantly to our company's success.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join a growing Finance & Strategy team, acting as a crucial link between Finance leaders and partners across the entire organization. You will principally be responsible for driving our financial planning process, inclusive of: budgeting, scaling processes & tooling, and cross functional communication / thought partnership. Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Financial Planning & Analysis: Develop comprehensive financial plans and forecasts aligned with our strategic objectives, and manage financial planning cadence & processes, including budgeting and variance analyses.

  • Financial Close Coordination: Implement scalable practices in financial close and accounting processes, partnering with our Financial Operations team to install and document accounting workflows / best practices.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with various departments to distill complex financial data into real-time insights that drive decision making.

  • Automation Through AI: Lead end-to-end efforts to enhance and automate financial processes and systems with AI tooling, from reporting to insight generation to cross-functional partnership.

  • Strategic Partnership with Finance Leadership: Work on a number of strategic areas alongside the Finance Leaders, including board & investor presentations and executive reporting.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in Big 4 Audit, Transaction Services, Investing, Management Consulting or a closely related field with experience in technical accounting, financial modeling, valuation, and/or deal diligence.

  • Additional cross-functional FP&A operating experience in a fast-paced technology and/or healthcare environment is a significant plus, but not a requirement.

  • Proficient in financial analysis and Microsoft Excel, with strong analytical skills and data interpretation abilities.

  • Systems architect mindset, focus on building / simplifying products and processes, willingness to engage in new systems and tools (e.g. AI enablement).

  • Experience researching, summarizing, and presenting complex financial data to non-financial stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • Team play & commitment to providing world-class cross-functional service.

  • A deep desire to build, contribute and learn.

We value people who want to learn new things, and we know that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

The Opportunity

CACI's Enterprise Network Services (ENS) Division supports the Department of Defense (DoD) in modernizing mission-critical communications and enterprise network infrastructures. Our team of network and cybersecurity professionals designs, implements, secures, operates, and enhances DoD enterprise environments to strengthen national security.

We are seeking a motivated Cybersecurity Engineer with approximately two years of professional experience to support the deployment, integration, and sustainment of cybersecurity solutions across customer environments. The ideal candidate is technically proficient, eager to learn, and comfortable supporting both CONUS and OCONUS customer sites.

Attention: This is a remote position that requires frequent travel (up to 50%) to customer sites within the U.S. (CONUS) and internationally (OCONUS).

Responsibilities

  • Configure, deploy, integrate, and maintain cybersecurity solutions based on customer requirements, security policies, and performance specifications.
  • Perform Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) compliance validation and remediation activities across network and system components.
  • Execute vulnerability assessments using industry-standard scanning tools and assist in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating security vulnerabilities.
  • SupportRisk Management Framework (RMF) activitiesand maintain compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Assist with system security hardening, configuration management, and secure baseline implementation.
  • Collaborate with government personnel, vendors, and subcontractors to integrate security solutions into existing enterprise infrastructures.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve cybersecurity and network security issues while documenting findings and recommended corrective actions.
  • Communicate technical security concepts, risks, and remediation plans effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, and customer briefings.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, security procedures, and system diagrams.
  • Support system integration, testing, and cybersecurity validation efforts during deployments.
  • Serve as a technical resource during customer meetings, engineering reviews, and operational support activities.
  • Travel up to 50% to CONUS and OCONUS customer locations to support installation, integration, troubleshooting, and sustainment activities.
  • Ensure compliance with CACI Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), ethics, and corporate compliance policies.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance with the ability to maintain clearance.
  • Approximately 2+ years of experience supporting cybersecurity, information assurance, or network security initiatives
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (Security+ CE or equivalent), or the ability to obtain certification within a specified timeframe.
  • Experience performing STIG implementation, validation, and remediation.
  • Experience conducting vulnerability scans using tools such as ACAS/Tenable Nessus or equivalent vulnerability management platforms.
  • Working knowledge of theDoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) and cybersecurity compliance requirements.
  • Understanding of secure network architecture, system hardening, and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems in enterprise environments.
  • Knowledge ofTCP/IP networking fundamentals and common network security technologies.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify and resolve technical issues.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional engineering teams.

Desired:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience supporting DoD programs or other federal government environments.
  • Experience with the DoD Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS).
  • Familiarity with Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) architectures and deployments.
  • Knowledge of Software Defined Networking (SDN) technologies.
  • Experience with endpoint security, firewalls, VPNs, identity and access management, or network security appliances.
  • Industry networking certifications such asCCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or JNCIP.
  • Experience using Microsoft Visio, AutoCAD, or similar tools to develop network and security diagrams.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash to automate administrative or security tasks.
This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

$63,300-$129,700

jobs.description:
Paragon ist eine inhabergeführte Beteiligungsgesellschaft und steht seit 2004 für nachhaltige Investitionen in mittelständische Unternehmen. Wir verwalten aktuell insgesamt € 2,4 Mrd. Eigenkapital. Zu unseren Investoren gehören institutionelle Anleger wie Lebensversicherungen, Pensionskassen und Universitätsstiftungen, sowie das Team von Paragon.

Wir beteiligen uns an etablierten, mittelständischen Unternehmen mit nachhaltigem Geschäftsmodell und signifikantem Entwicklungspotenzial. Jedes von uns erworbene Unternehmen wird unabhängig durch die Geschäftsführung geführt und selbstständig finanziert. Wir begleiten unsere Beteiligungen aus einer Beiratsposition und unterstützen die Management-Teams dabei, die Unternehmen strategisch und operativ nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Für neue Beteiligungsansätze besetzen wir die Position CFO (gn).

In der Rolle als CFO (gn) werden Sie maßgeblich zum Erfolg einer Portfolio Firma beitragen. Ihre Mission ist es die Transformation, Professionalisierung und positive Wertentwicklung des Unternehmens zu begleiten.

Mit einem guten Überblick über die Finanzfunktion und einem klaren Verständnis der primären Hebel für die Value Creation eines Unternehmens schafft der CFO die Transparenz, um das Porfolio Unternehmen zu steuern.

Als CFO sind Sie für die strategische Ausrichtung und operative Steuerung des Bereichs Finanzen und Controlling verantwortlich.

Das Aufgabenspektrum:

  • Budgetierung, Forecasting und Cash-Flow-Management, Treasury

  • Accounting, Tax, Jahresabschluss

  • Reporting und Erstellung von Finanzberichten

  • Ausbau und Pflege eines effektiven Controllingsystems

  • Erstellung von Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen

  • Definition und Monitoring der Key Performance Indicators

  • Fallweise auch Human Resources, IT und Recht

Darüber hinaus umfassen Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten:

  • Prozessoptimierung und Professionalisierung im Finanzbereich durch Schaffung transparenter Strukturen, Digitalisierung und Einführung von Systemen

  • Mitwirkung bei der strategischen Planung und Unterstützung bei Investitionsentscheidungen, sowie M&A Aktivitäten

  • Aufbau und personelle Weiterentwicklung der Finanzabteilung, einschließlich der Entwicklung und Rekrutierung von Fachpersonal

  • Analyse und Aufbereitung von Finanzdaten für die Geschäftsführung und Shareholder, um Grundlagen für die strategische Planung, Geschäftsentwicklung und Hebung von Wertsteigerungspotenzialen zu schaffen

  • Ansprechpartner in Finanzierungsfragen und Verhandlung mit Banken und Finanzierungspartnern

  • Etablieren einer Performance Kultur

  • Vorbereitung eines Unternehmensverkaufs (Exit), Leitung aller work streams, Aufbau des Datenraums und Zusammenarbeit mit externen Beratern

  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Rechnungslegungsstandards, Steuervorschriften und Compliance-Richtlinien

Requirements

Die Rolle des CFO (gn) in einem mittelständischen, internationalen Unternehmen unter Private Equity Ownership verlangt ein hohes Mass an intellektueller Bandbreite gepaart mit pragmatischer Umsetzungsorientierung. In dieser spezifischen Situation wird eine entscheidungsfreudige Führungskraft gesucht, die durch Ihre ausgesprochene Zahlenaffinität, Weitblick und analytische Schärfe überzeugt. Ihre natürliche Autorität, verbunden mit Durch- und Umsetzungsstärke sowie ausgeprägtem Gestaltungswillen ermöglicht es Ihnen, unternehmerische Akzente zu setzen und die Gesellschaft auf das nächste Level zu heben. Man schätzt Ihre gute Kommunikations- und Integrationsfähigkeit, Ihre hohe Eigenverantwortung, Authentizität und Nahbarkeit.

  • Passion für den deutschen Mittelstand, daher einerseits operativ in der Umsetzung, aber auch strategisch mit Weitblick agierend

  • Ausgesprochene Zahlenaffinität, Weitblick und analytische Schärfe

  • Situationen schnell durchdringen und beurteilen, zügig Entscheidungen auf der Basis von Fakten treffen und notwendige Maßnahmen umsetzen

  • Transformationsexpertise, nachweislicher Erfolg in der Professionalisierung, Restrukturierung von Unternehmen

  • Zielstrebigkeit und unternehmerisch, um die Gesellschaft auf das nächste Level zu heben.

  • exzellente Kommunikations- und Integrationsfähigkeiten

  • hohe Eigenverantwortung, Authentizität und Nahbarkeit, Belastbarkeit und hohes Energielevel

  • breite Erfahrung in der Führung einer Finanzabteilung und mindestens fünf Jahre Führungsexpertise (Accounting, Controlling), idealerweise auch im Aufbau einer Finanzorganisation

  • Transaktionserfahrung durch erfolgreichen Unternehmensverkauf, Erfahrung in Unternehmenskäufen und -integrationen

This executive-level leader will own strategy and execution across ERP and technology partners, financial institutions, value‑added resellers, system integrators, and indirect channels.

    Reporting into the C-suite, this role carries significant visibility and cross‑functional influence, with direct accountability for partner‑driven pipeline, revenue impact, and long‑term platform expansion. The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with operational rigor and brings a systems-oriented mindset to building high‑value, durable partnerships.

    • Partnership Strategy & Ecosystem Design: Define and execute a comprehensive partnerships strategy spanning ERP providers, fintech platforms, financial institutions, VARs, ISVs and indirect channels, aligned to Versapay’s growth objectives.

    • Revenue & Pipeline Ownership: Drive measurable pipeline creation and revenue contribution through co‑sell, embedded finance, white‑label, and channel motions—from partner identification through commercial execution and onboarding.

    • Executive Partner Management: Own senior relationships with strategic partners, leading complex negotiations, structuring innovative commercial models, and setting joint success metrics.

    • Cross‑Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Risk, and Legal to ensure partnerships are scalable, compliant, differentiated, and tightly integrated into go‑to‑market execution.

    • Market & Technology Insight: Stay ahead of trends in B2B payments, embedded finance, ERP ecosystems, and AI‑enabled workflows to inform partnership strategy and product direction.

Why This Role Matters

jobs.excerpt: About This RoleEvery day, WWF's conservation teams across the globe rely on robust, secure cloud infrastructure to protect wildlife, engage communities, and drive climate action.
jobs.description:
About This Role

Every day, WWF's conservation teams across the globe rely on robust, secure cloud infrastructure to protect wildlife, engage communities, and drive climate action. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll be the foundational force ensuring our technology systems enable this global impact by managing mission-critical infrastructure that directly supports conservation programs.

In this position, you'll directly enable WWF-US and our network of Country Offices across South America, Central America, Africa, and Asia to operate seamlessly. Your work ensures that critical systems stay online so our teams can focus on what matters most: protecting nature at scale.

What You'll Do:

Own Our Azure Infrastructure
You'll be the architect behind WWF's Azure environment, spinning up subscriptions, provisioning resources, and building/deploying VMs (Windows, SQL, Red Hat, firewalls) from the ground up in both production and staging.

Lock Down Security & Identity
Configure Microsoft Entra tenants, manage SSO through Azure Enterprise Apps, and keep our RBAC and user groups clean and secure. You'll patch systems proactively and use PowerShell + Graph API to automate the boring stuff so the important stuff runs smoother.

Be Our Safety Net
Design backup strategies and disaster recovery playbooks that actually work when it matters. You're the reason we sleep at night knowing our systems can bounce back from anything.

Keep Everything Connected
Troubleshoot networking across VNETs, sites, and tenants. Firewalls, load balancers, DNS (Azure + Cloudflare), you speak the language fluently and fix problems before they become fires.

Be the Go-To Expert
When Azure, Entra ID, or M365 issues get complicated, you're who the team calls. You'll lead projects end-to-end and keep stakeholders, technical and non-technical alike, in the loop every step of the way.

Show Up When It Counts
Occasional after-hours or weekend work for critical outages or planned maintenance, because uptime matters, and so does the team that protects it.

Key Competencies

  • Ability to Multitask. Demonstrates strong technical and operational agility, effectively navigating complex business and cloud environments to deliver tailored, high-quality support across WWF’s Azure and multi-cloud platforms.
  • Solution-Oriented and Strategic Collaboration. Clear, influential communicator who leads projects end-to-end, ensuring alignment, transparency, and active engagement with stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Growth Mindset. Demonstrates a strong growth mindset, continually expanding expertise in evolving cloud, automation, and security technologies and applying new knowledge to strengthen WWF’s technical capabilities.
  • Big Picture Thinking. Strategic acumen complemented by robust technical proficiency
  • Collaborative. Proven ability to work effectively as part of a team
  • Project Management. Strong organizational, documentation, and project management capabilities, including development of comprehensive project plans

Skills and Abilities

  • Degree in IT or related field AND minimum of 8 years of work experience (including at least 6 years of experience in IT)

  • MUST HAVE Verbal and written fluency in English and Spanish

  • Experience managing large-scale enterprise IT systems

  • Extensive hands-on experience managing highly available and resilient Azure production systems.

  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, cloud architecture, cloud networking, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Windows and Linux servers

  • Proficient in managing Windows domains and Active Directory

  • Expertise in using PowerShell and Graph API for Azure management, workflow automation, and deployment orchestration

  • Familiarity with provisioning and managing access for technologies such as Fabric, Power BI, and Azure Foundry

  • Experience integrating Microsoft Copilot for M365, Copilot Studio, and Copilot Agents into enterprise Azure/M365 environments, including configuration and governance of data access controls

  • Significant expertise in building, deploying, and managing virtual machines in Azure from inception

  • History of applying structured thinking to diagnose complex cloud or hybrid system issues and develop scalable, sustainable solutions.

  • Well-honed methodologies for diagnosing and troubleshooting technical issues.

  • Broad enterprise scale expertise across infrastructure, Azure cloud architecture, identity and access management with Entra ID, and emerging AI‑ driven‑ automation technologies—enabling the evaluation and recommendation of modernization opportunities, security improvements, and strategic technology replacements. skills in configuring Microsoft Entra tenants and domains, including DNS and VNET setup.

  • Committed to building and strengthening a culture of inclusion within and across teams.

  • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values:

    • COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home.

    • INTEGRITY – We live the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve.

    • RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future.

    • COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation.

Please note: Candidates must be currently based and authorized to work in one of the following countries to be eligible for this position: Bolivia, Chile, Ecuador, Guatemala, Belize, Honduras, Mexico, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, or Guyana.

Remuneration: Salary and benefits for this position will be paid in local currency.

Application instructions: Resumes and cover letters must be submitted in English to be considered for this position

Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the job's location. Position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Entrepreneur in Residence – Fashion & Luxury AI Venture | BIANCO VENTURES
jobs.excerpt: Bianco Ventures è un company builder verticale dedicato alla creazione di startup software B2B per il mondo Fashion & Luxury.
jobs.description:
Bianco Ventures è un company builder verticale dedicato alla creazione di startup software B2B per il mondo Fashion & Luxury. Uniamo capitale, execution e conoscenza profonda del mercato fin dal primo giorno, insieme a partner come Deloitte, GELLIFY e ARAD, per costruire nuove imprese con chi conosce il settore dall'interno.

Non siamo un fondo. Non siamo un acceleratore. Costruiamo imprese vere, partendo da problemi veri.

La venture oggetto di questa ricerca è la prima iniziativa live del nostro ecosistema. Stiamo cercando la persona che la guidi.

La sfida

Nelle organizzazioni retail distribuite, decine, centinaia di punti vendita, mercati diversi, team locali con autonomia operativa, il coordinamento tra struttura centrale e rete è uno dei problemi più persistenti e ancora poco risolti dalla tecnologia.

Le linee guida partono dall'HQ. Cosa succede dopo è spesso invisibile. L'execution reale, la qualità con cui le direttive diventano azione nei singoli store, viene misurata tardi, se viene misurata. I dati ci sono, ma sono frammentati, manuali, non strutturati.

Questo è il problema che stiamo affrontando.

La venture

Stiamo costruendo una piattaforma B2B software e AI focalizzata sulla retail execution e sull'operational intelligence per il Fashion, il Luxury e il Retail mid-market.

La venture nasce da un'analisi concreta del mercato e da interlocuzioni dirette con i decision maker del settore. La tesi di mercato è sviluppata. La value proposition iniziale è strutturata. Il problema è reale e ancora largamente irrisolto dagli strumenti oggi disponibili.

Siamo in fase early-stage. Il prodotto e il modello di business devono ancora essere validati e costruiti, questa è esattamente la ragione per cui stiamo cercando chi voglia farlo.

Il ruolo

Cerchiamo un'Entrepreneur in Residence che agisca come founder operativa/o della venture.

Non si tratta di un incarico consulenziale. Non è un ruolo di product management interno. Non è innovation management.

È ownership reale di un'impresa in costruzione: dalla customer discovery alla prima revenue, dalla definizione del prodotto alla creazione del team, dal go-to-market alla preparazione allo spin-off.

Avrai autonomia concreta. Avrai il supporto di un ecosistema attivo. Avrai accesso a stakeholder industriali che raramente si trovano nella stessa stanza.

Cosa farai nei primi 6–9 mesi

Nei primi mesi costruirai le fondamenta operative e commerciali della venture. In concreto:

  • Approfondirai la customer discovery, intervistando Retail Director, Head of VM, COO e altri decision maker del settore, per validare il problema e misurare la willingness to pay
  • Raffinerai la value proposition in dialogo con il mercato reale, non con ipotesi interne
  • Coordinerai la costruzione dell'MVP con il team tecnologico, definendo le priorità di prodotto in funzione di ciò che hai imparato sul campo
  • Progetterai e gestirai i primi pilot con brand selezionati, raccogliendo evidenze qualitative e quantitative
  • Definirai il modello commerciale (pricing, segmentazione, struttura contrattuale) partendo dai dati, non da benchmark generici
  • Costruirai il go-to-market iniziale e acquisirai i primi clienti paganti
  • Coordinerai partner tecnologici, fornitori e risorse dedicate
  • Definirai KPI e milestone della venture e le presenterai agli stakeholder e ai potenziali investitori
  • Costruirai il primo team intorno alla venture
  • Preparerai la società allo spin-off e al fundraising seed

Chi cerchiamo

Consideriamo profili con 5–10 anni di esperienza che abbiano lavorato in almeno uno di questi ambiti: startup early-stage, venture building, product management B2B, growth, SaaS enterprise, retail tech, AI o innovation.

Quello che non è negoziabile:

  • Capacità di condurre customer discovery in contesti enterprise, sapere ascoltare, sapere sintetizzare, sapere cambiare idea quando i dati lo richiedono
  • Attitudine commerciale: saper portare una soluzione davanti a un buyer, gestire il ciclo di vendita, chiudere
  • Capacità di lavorare con team tecnologici senza essere necessariamente tecnici: sapere cosa chiedere, come prioritizzare, come tradurre feedback di mercato in decisioni di prodotto
  • Leadership cross-funzionale in contesti ad alta ambiguità: non serve aver fatto tutto, serve saper operare quando le risposte non ci sono ancora
  • Comunicazione efficace con interlocutori senior come executive di brand, investitori, partner istituzionali
  • Inglese professionale fluente

Quello che consideriamo un plus significativo:

  • Precedente esperienza da founder, anche in iniziative che non sono decollate
  • Conoscenza diretta del Fashion, Luxury o Retail, da operatore, consulente o builder di soluzioni per il settore
  • Vendita di soluzioni SaaS in contesti enterprise o corporate
  • Esposizione a AI applicata, workflow automation o operational intelligence
  • Esperienza in fundraising o nella gestione di pilot con grandi organizzazioni
  • Esperienza in pricing B2B e strutturazione di modelli commerciali

Non stiamo cercando una persona che abbia già fatto tutto questo. Stiamo cercando una persona che sappia costruire partendo dall'incertezza, che trasformi l'ambiguità in direzione e la direzione in azione.

Cosa offriamo

Non partirai da zero.

Troverai una tesi di mercato già sviluppata, un problema identificato, una value proposition strutturata e un ecosistema attivo che include:

  • Supporto diretto e continuativo del team Bianco Ventures
  • Supporto strategico e go-to-market di Deloitte
  • Sviluppo tecnologico e venture building di GELLIFY
  • Competenze manageriali verticali sul Fashion & Luxury di ARAD
  • Accesso al network di stakeholder industriali, prospect e potenziali clienti nel settore
  • Risorse dedicate alla costruzione della venture
  • Compenso durante il periodo da EIR
  • Equity nella società al momento dello spin-off
  • Concreta opportunità di diventare CEO e co-founder della venture
  • Esposizione a partner industriali, investitori e top executive del settore Fashion & Luxury

Le condizioni economiche e la struttura dell'equity saranno discusse durante il processo di selezione.

Come candidarsi

Crediamo che le persone straordinarie si riconoscano da come pensano, non solo dal CV.
Oltre a inviare il tuo CV o profilo LinkedIn, ti chiediamo di allegare un breve video Loom (max 1 minuto) in cui ci racconti:

  1. Quale problema irrisolto nel Fashion, Luxury o Retail ti interessa maggiormente oggi e perché?
  2. Raccontaci qualcosa che hai costruito o validato partendo da zero.
  3. Quali sarebbero le tue prime tre priorità entrando come EIR in una venture B2B AI early-stage?

Non serve un video perfetto: vogliamo solo conoscerti, capire il tuo modo di pensare e sentire la tua energia.

🎬 Registra su loom.com (o un qualsiasi link video privato) e condividilo nel form di candidatura.

jobs.description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses to supporting their clients in arranging "me time" moments, we’re in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that’s scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment with clear processes and structures, then we’ve got to be honest: you won’t always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritizing your own path within ambiguity, then you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

Requirements

As the Lead Analytics Engineer (Looker), reporting into the Analytics Manager, you will be the primary architect of our data’s "source of truth." You will lead a team of high-performing Analytics Engineers dedicated to transforming raw data into actionable insights through a sophisticated Looker semantic layer.

This is a hybrid role requiring both technical mastery and strategic leadership. You will act as the bridge between Data Engineering (infrastructure), Data Analysts and our Corporate, Marketing, CS, Sales and GTM Ops Teams (consumers), ensuring our data models are scalable, automated, and governed by rigorous CI/CD practices. Your mission is to eliminate manual toil and empower the organisation with true self-service capabilities.

Your core responsibilities will include:

People Leadership & Development:

  • Mentorship & Coaching: Lead the AE team, drive a high-performance culture, and support individual career growth.
  • Performance Management: Drive regular 1-on-1s, give constructive feedback, and handle performance reviews.
  • Resource Planning: Manage team capacity and sprint priorities, balancing tech debt with stakeholder needs.
  • Talent Growth: Help with recruitment and make sure new joiners have a smooth onboarding.

Semantic Architecture & Governance:

  • Own the Layer: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of centralised Looker semantic models (LookML).
  • Guardianship: Act as the "Gatekeeper" for Looker, enforcing coding standards, modularity, and performance optimisation.
  • CI/CD Implementation: Establish and manage robust version control and deployment pipelines in GitLab for the semantic layer.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Upstream Influence: Partner with Data Engineering to define table structures and schemas that optimize for downstream analytical performance.

jobs.description:
Location:

Remote with frequent trips.

Position:

Client is seeking an experienced PLC Programmer SCADA Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support our rapidly expanding Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) and renewable energy portfolio. This role will provide expert-level PLC programming and SCADA integration support for utility-scale projects, ensuring seamless commissioning and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

PLC Programming & Development

  • Expert-level PLC programming for BESS and solar projects using Schneider M340/M580 platforms
  • Develop, modify, and optimize control logic for utility-scale energy storage systems
  • Create and maintain standardized PLC code libraries and templates
  • Implement advanced control algorithms for hybrid PV-BESS operations

SCADA Integration & Communications

  • Configure and troubleshoot Modbus communications between PLCs, inverters, and SCADA systems
  • Integrate PLCs with Ignition HMI platforms and historian systems
  • Establish robust communication protocols for real-time monitoring and control
  • Support OPC server configuration and data exchange protocols

Testing & Commissioning Support

  • Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) procedures
  • Perform comprehensive PLC code validation and system integration testing
  • Support commissioning teams with on-site troubleshooting and system optimization
  • Execute Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) and Large Generator Interconnection Agreement (LGIA) testing requirements

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Serve as technical SME for PLC programming standards and best practices
  • Coordinate with SCADA leads, project managers, and vendor teams
  • Provide technical guidance for control system architecture decisions

Documentation & Standards

  • Develop and maintain PLC programming documentation and procedures
  • Create detailed Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) for control systems
  • Establish coding standards and version control protocols

Support regulatory compliance documentation (NERC CIP, cybersecurity

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in PLC programming, preferably Schneider Electric platforms
  • Expert knowledge of Modbus, DNP3, and industrial communication protocols
  • Experience with Ignition SCADA platform and HMI development
  • Strong understanding of power systems and utility-scale energy project
  • Proven experience in utility-scale renewable energy or power generation projects
  • Knowledge of BESS control systems, inverters, and energy storage technologies
  • Familiarity with grid interconnection requirements and utility standards
  • Experience with FAT/SAT testing procedures and commissioning protocols
  • Full accountability for PPA, LGIA, and OEM testing completion
  • Ability to travel up to 25% for project commissioning support
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities
  • NERC CIP cybersecurity awareness preferred

Physical Requirements / Working Environment

  • Ability to lift up to 20 pounds frequently on a daily basis.
  • Standing on feet for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to work at desk position in front of a computer monitor for extensive periods of time.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle for purposes of commuting between 2 working locations.
  • Ability to travel as required.

Teachers monitor student progress through Stride K12’s learning management system. They actively work closely with students and parents/learning coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, such as state testing or as otherwise required by the school.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, North Carolina Virtual Academy (NCVA). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

This is a full-time position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

  • Commitment to personalizing learning for all students

  • Demonstrates a belief in all students’ ability to succeed and meet high expectations

  • Differentiates instruction based on student level of mastery

  • Augments course content according to prescribed policies and procedures using appropriate asynchronous and synchronous tools under guidance from principal and coach

  • Maintains grade book ensuring student academic integrity, makes student placement and promotion decisions, and alerts administrators to concerns about student performance and progress

  • Ability to clear required background check

jobs.excerpt: About the Role:You track culture before it surfaces in a brief.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

You track culture before it surfaces in a brief. You have strong opinions about what makes content work on a platform, and you understand how audiences truly behave—how they form communities, participate in conversations, and move between discovery and action. You bring craft to strategy: your briefs sharpen the problem, your frameworks drive execution, and your thinking gives creative and community teams somewhere real to go.

ServiceNow's social presence is where we reach enterprise buyers across the platforms where they're actually present—Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, and emerging channels. We're building an always-on social program rooted in authentic storytelling, cultural relevance, and genuine community engagement—one that proves B2B tech can be creative, insightful, and genuinely interesting.

This role owns the strategic vision for ServiceNow's social and content program across all platforms and partners with creative teams, product marketing, editorial leadership, and community managers to bring that strategy to life with excellence and intention. You'll define what our brand sounds like and stands for in social spaces. You'll identify where to expand and evolve our content approach based on audience behaviors and insights. You'll tap into and activate our community to find moments that drive buzz and cultural relevance.

You'll report to the Director of Social Media with direct accountability for building brand awareness, credibility, and relevance across social channels.

What You'll Do:

  • Own Social Strategy Across Social Platforms: Define the strategic vision and positioning for ServiceNow across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, and emerging channels. Develop a forward-looking roadmap aligned to our editorial calendar, product launches, thought leadership moments, and cultural opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand into new content pillars and evolve existing pillars based on audience behaviors, engagement patterns, and strategic insights. Establish clear audience targets and platform-specific strategies that reflect how to reach enterprise buyers organically across each channel.

  • Build Content Architecture: Develop integrated content strategies and always-on programming architectures that translate ServiceNow's positioning into scalable, channel-native programs. Serve as steward of the brand across social, ensuring all content reflects our visual standards, tone, and perspective. Partner closely with creative teams to brief, concept, and execute channel-right content across photo, video, thought leadership, and community-generated content. Write creative briefs and social strategies that give creative teams a genuine problem to solve, framing the strategic challenge with precision, clear point of view, and useful constraints. Test content formats and creative approaches to optimize for engagement, reach, and audience connection.

  • Cultivate & Activate Community: Tap into and activate ServiceNow's community of practitioners, builders, and decision-makers to uncover insights and identify moments of cultural relevance. Mine community conversations and user-generated content for signals that inform new strategic challenges and social moments. Develop community-first campaigns and activations that drive buzz, engagement, and strengthen brand perception. Build a community-first mindset into the always-on program that strengthens brand perception and creates space for authentic dialogue.

  • Leverage Performance & Insights: Use performance data and audience insights to refine content strategy, optimize for emerging opportunities, and identify moments worth amplifying. Translate analytics and learning into strategic recommendations that inform content evolution and platform investment. Make the case for strategic pivots and new directions backed by evidence and cultural insight.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with product marketing to identify moments to integrate ServiceNow products and narratives into social storytelling. Collaborate with editorial and brand strategy teams to ensure social strategy aligns with broader brand positioning and messaging. Work with customer marketing and proof teams to bring customer success stories and proof points to life on social—identifying authentic moments and opportunities to amplify customer advocacy. Work with paid media and performance teams to identify amplification opportunities and ensure social content gets the media support it deserves. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across creative, product, data, and marketing disciplines.

  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitor trends across business, tech, culture, and social media to inform proactive, culturally relevant activations. Track platform evolution, emerging features, and shifts in audience behavior across all channels. Build and maintain social listening programs and cultural trendspotting frameworks that inform strategic decisions. Be the person who flags when we need to try something new before everyone else does.

What You Need:

  • 10+ years of demonstrated experience in social and content strategy, with a track record of building differentiated strategies (not just executing against an existing calendar) across brand channels, always-on programs, or editorial-led social presence.

  • Deep platform fluency across LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms. You understand algorithmic distribution, paid amplification mechanics, community dynamics, and how cultural moments surface and move across platforms. You know the difference between platform best practices and genuine cultural insight.

  • Proven strategic leadership defining content architecture, positioning, and audience strategy for always-on brand channels. You've shaped how a brand shows up in social spaces with consistency, intention, and authenticity.

  • Brief-writing and strategic communication craft. Your briefs create useful constraints, build a clear point of view, and give creative teams problems worth solving. You can distill complex brand challenges into actionable narratives and present strategic work with confidence.

  • Data literacy and analytical rigor. You know how to define the right KPIs, interpret performance dashboards, and translate findings into strategic decisions. You're comfortable asking hard questions when you don't have the answers yet.

  • Experience in B2B, tech, or complex categories where audience trust, credibility, and thought leadership matter. Bonus if you've worked in AI, enterprise software, or similar spaces.

  • Strong cross-functional operator mindset. You build trust with stakeholders across disciplines—from creatives to product teams to executives—and lead through influence and the quality of your work, not just authority.

  • Creative judgment and attention to detail. You have a strong point of view on what makes content work. You care deeply about consistency, craft, and quality. You understand that millions of eyes may see your work—it must be excellent.

  • Entrepreneurial spirit. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, parachuting into unfamiliar territory, rapidly developing context, and moving with confidence. You introduce and establish new ways of working.

jobs.title: Sr Talent Partner
jobs.excerpt: About Us We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That’s not a policy. It’s just who we are.

What keeps us going is what we hear from our Community. Families tell us they used to wake up every morning with a knot in their stomach. They don’t anymore. They tell us our product changed their relationship with their parents, from anxious and fearful to present and connected. It’s genuinely important work, and we don’t take it lightly.

If that’s the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years on, one with real scale, real mission, real momentum, and a real Community of people behind it, we’d love to talk.

Why this role exists

Most companies fill their first recruiting seat with someone who runs a process. We're not doing that. We've hired recruiters before who could source and coordinate but couldn't tell us who was actually good. We ended up doing the real evaluation ourselves every time, which meant the hire added activity, not leverage. This role is built to fix that specifically: we're hiring for judgment first, process second.

You'll own full-cycle recruiting across every function starting day one, and you'll build the operating system: sourcing, interview loops, scorecards. But the actual bar is narrower and harder than "can you run a process": can we trust your read on a candidate enough to act on it without redoing the work ourselves?

What you'll own

  • Full-cycle recruiting (sourcing, evaluation, closing) across GTM, engineering/product, and ops.
  • The recruiting operating system: ATS, interview structure, scorecards, sourcing channels, built from scratch, not inherited.
  • Direct partnership with the CEO/COO and hiring managers on role scoping and hiring bar: you help set the bar, not just fill against it.
  • Hiring metrics that actually inform decisions (time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, quality of hire), not vanity throughput numbers.
  • Candidate experience and employer brand: often a candidate's first real signal of what working here is like.

What we're testing for

  • Independent, evidence-based candidate judgment. As part of the process, you'll evaluate real, anonymized candidate profiles from our own hiring history, and we'll compare your read to what actually happened. This is the single most important thing we're screening for, more than years of experience or past titles.
  • Sourcing alpha. Knowing what circles the best candidates swim in and generating conversations with great people who might be least likely to apply through LinkedIn.
  • Full-cycle recruiting experience at an early-stage or fast-growing company, ideally as a founding or very early recruiting hire.
  • Intelligence and clarity of thinking. During the calibration phase, for example, we're asking if you can contribute to the discovery of the ideal candidate profile.
  • Range across functions: equally comfortable evaluating a growth hire and an engineer in the same week.
  • A track record of delivering results and taking end-to-end responsibility for them, not just operating inside someone else's system.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and founder-speed decision-making. There's no recruiting manager above you, just the CEO and COO.

Nice to have

  • Recruiting experience in high growth, hardware, or consumer software subscription environments.
  • Employer branding or content chops: job posts and outreach that actually convert.
  • Prior experience leading or managing a recruiting team. We're growing quickly, and this role has a real path to building and leading a team, not just staying an individual contributor indefinitely.

The opportunity

This is a founding seat, not a fill-the-req seat. Whoever takes this defines how the company hires for years: the bar, the process, the tools, the brand. You'll start as an IC, closing key gaps yourself, but as we scale, there's a genuine opportunity to build and lead the recruiting team you start out running solo. If you've been the strongest recruiter in the room but never had the mandate to build the whole function your way, this is that mandate.

Reports to: COO
Location: SF/Bay Area or US Remote
Compensation: $140,000–$170,000 base

At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.
