your mission

Over the years, partnerships have been one of the most powerful and capital-efficient channels for our business. From a historical base of 192 interested leads generated through partner introductions and referrals — resulting in 19 past customers and 4 active customers, including a publicly traded company acquired through our Remote.com partnership — we know this motion works.


As Partnerships Manager, You will own and scale this engine. This is a builder role: starting from a strong foundation of informal relationships and past wins, you will formalize and grow two distinct partnership pipelines — Commercial and Marketing — that together drive revenue, brand visibility, and long-term strategic positioning.


Business Context & Partnership Model

Our partnerships have historically operated across two value streams:


Commercial Partnerships — Revenue & Lead Generation

The commercial partnerships model is straightforward: we work with organisations whose clients or members are likely to need our services, and we structure introductions, referrals (paid and unpaid), and co-selling arrangements. Partners act as a trusted channel into qualified networks — shortening our sales cycle and increasing close rates because leads arrive with built-in credibility.


The Remote.com partnership is a strong proof point: it brought us a publicly traded company as a customer. The next phase is about systematising what worked, identifying more partners in adjacent categories, and making the pipeline predictable.


Target commercial partner categories include:

  • Business accelerators and startup programmes

  • Accounting and financial advisory firms that can refer their clients to us

  • Networks similar to YPO, StartX, YC

  • Venture capital and investor networks

  • Capital providers and debt financing firms

  • Due diligence and compliance consultancies

  • Companies specialising in remote talent and distributed workforce solutions

  • Providers of complementary services (HR tech, legal, payroll, etc.)


Secondary Priority: Marketing Partnerships — Brand Credibility & Presence

Marketing partnerships operate on a different logic: they increase our surface area in the market and make our brand, our people, and our clients visible to audiences we do not yet reach. jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyWe are an international iGaming affiliate project developing and scaling SEO-driven websites across Tier 1 and Tier 2 markets.
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are an international iGaming affiliate project developing and scaling SEO-driven websites across Tier 1 and Tier 2 markets.

Our current focus is Poland and Hungary, with plans to expand into additional markets such as Greece and New Zealand.

We operate with a lean team and a highly automated approach. Our model is based on launching and testing multiple SEO projects using expired domains, parasite SEO, one-page websites, rapid migrations, and gray-hat promotion methods.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on SEO Specialist who can independently manage the full lifecycle of multiple affiliate projects.

This is not a traditional Team Lead position. There is no large team of junior specialists to delegate routine work to. You will personally work with domains, keywords, websites, content, links, rankings, and performance data.

The role is suitable for a strong Middle or Senior SEO Specialist who is comfortable working autonomously, testing hypotheses quickly, and taking direct responsibility for project results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple SEO projects from domain selection to traffic and monetisation.

  • Research, evaluate, and acquire expired domains.

  • Analyse competitors, SERPs, keywords, niches, and growth opportunities.

  • Launch and develop one-page affiliate websites and parasite SEO projects.

  • Prepare domains and keyword sets for automated website deployment.

  • Work closely with an internal developer responsible for website automation.

  • Review launched websites, including content, structure, HTML tags, markup, and technical implementation.

  • Make basic changes directly through WordPress, CMS platforms, Cloudflare, or website admin panels.

  • Monitor rankings, indexing, traffic, backlink profiles, conversions, and monetisation.

  • Develop and execute link-building strategies.

  • Purchase, place, and monitor links.

  • Identify underperforming websites and decide whether to improve, migrate, or replace them.

  • Test SEO hypotheses across multiple websites and GEOs.

  • Scale approaches that demonstrate positive results.

  • Maintain clear reporting on project launches, rankings, tests, and outcomes.

  • Use AI tools to improve content, fix basic HTML issues, and support day-to-day SEO tasks.

  • Contribute to improving internal workflows, automation, and SEO processes.

Key Requirements

  • Strong Middle or Senior-level SEO experience.

  • Hands-on experience with expired domains, including research, evaluation, acquisition, launch, and development.

  • Practical understanding of gray-hat or black-hat SEO methods.

  • Experience with parasite SEO, mass-site strategies, website migrations, or similar approaches.

  • Strong understanding of the full SEO cycle:

    • keyword research;

    • competitor and SERP analysis;

    • website structure;

    • content;

    • technical SEO;

    • link building;

    • indexing;

    • performance analysis.

  • Ability to manage several websites and experiments simultaneously.

  • Experience working in highly competitive GEOs and complex SERPs.

  • Practical knowledge of WordPress or similar CMS platforms.

  • Basic understanding of Cloudflare, HTML, page markup, tags, and technical website checks.

  • Ability to clearly assign tasks to developers and verify the completed work.

  • Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Semrush, Similarweb, Serpstat, or equivalent platforms.

  • Ability to analyse SEO performance and make decisions based on rankings, traffic, conversions, and commercial outcomes.

  • Strong personal organisation and ability to work independently.

  • Proactive approach and willingness to propose and test new solutions.

  • Comfortable working in an environment where many experiments may fail before a scalable approach is identified.

Relevant Industry Experience

Experience within iGaming or affiliate marketing is highly desirable but not mandatory.

We are also open to candidates from industries that use similar SEO methods, including:

  • dating;

  • pharma;

  • finance;

  • other competitive affiliate or gray-hat niches.

A strong practical background in expired domains, parasite SEO, mass-site launches, and gray-hat promotion methods is more important than experience in one specific industry.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with casino or betting affiliate websites.

  • Experience across Tier 1 and Tier 2 markets.

  • Experience working with large sports or news websites containing affiliate landing pages.

  • Experience developing internal SEO tools or automation.

  • Basic scripting or technical troubleshooting skills.

  • Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools for content and technical tasks.

  • Understanding of affiliate monetisation, conversion rates, and project profitability.

What Success Looks Like

During the first months, success will be assessed based on:

  • the number of relevant domains identified and acquired;

  • the number of websites successfully launched;

  • the speed and quality of project execution;

  • the number of websites indexed and gaining rankings;

  • the quality of technical and content reviews;

  • the number of SEO hypotheses tested;

  • the ability to independently manage a large volume of projects;

  • continuous improvement based on previous results.

We do not expect every project or experiment to succeed. We value speed, consistency, practical conclusions, and the ability to improve the approach over time.

Working Conditions

  • Fully remote.

  • Lean and highly autonomous working environment.

  • Communication primarily through Telegram.

  • Minimal meetings and no unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Close cooperation with the SEO lead and internal developer.

Hiring Process

  1. Talentin Interview.

  2. Short practical task requiring approximately 15 minutes.

  3. Interview with the SEO Lead.

  4. Possible final conversation with the project owner.

  5. Offer.

WHO ARE WE?

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Engineer to support and optimize a mature Microsoft 365 environment serving approximately 26,000 users. This role will work closely with the Senior Director, Enterprise Applications to learn and manage our established Microsoft 365 ecosystem. The focus will be on license management, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Microsoft Copilot, and especially the Power Platform including Power Automate and Power Apps. Broad expertise in Microsoft 365 required to ensure secure, scalable, and well-governed operations.

In addition to administratIon and operational support, this role will be responsible for engineering and implementing Microsoft 365 solutions, automation, integrations, and platform improvements that enhance collaboration, productivity, security, and user experience across the enterprise.

This role will report to the Senior Director, Enterprise Applications.

Microsoft 365 Administration

  • Configure and govern SharePoint Online and OneDrive including permissions, site architecture, retention, and external sharing

  • Administer Microsoft Teams collaboration including policies, provisioning, governance, and integrations.

  • Build and support integrations between Microsoft 365 services and enterprise applications using APIs, connectors, and low-code platforms.

  • Implement solution lifecycle management practices including development, testing, deployment, version control, and change management.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes through automation and engineering-driven operational improvements.

Security, Compliance, and Operations

  • Implement security best practices including conditional access, data loss prevention, retention, and compliance policies.

  • Monitor service health, usage, and performance across the tenant.

  • Troubleshoot complex Microsoft 365 issues and provide advanced operational support.

  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term engineering solutions to eliminate recurring operational issues and improve platform stability.

  • Maintain documentation, standards, and operational runbooks

  • Partner with IT Operations, Security, and business stakeholders to support enterprise collaboration and productivity services.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 5- 7 years of experience

  • Strong hands on experience administering Microsoft 365 in a large enterprise environment.

  • Demonstrated expertise with SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams.

  • Deep experience with Power Platform, especially Power Automate and Power Apps.

  • Experience managing Microsoft 365 licensing and tenant governance at scale.

  • Experience implementing Microsoft Copilot with appropriate security and governance controls.

  • Proficiency with PowerShell and administrative automation.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale Microsoft 365 solutions and platform architecture.

  • Experience with Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, application integrations, and automation engineering.

  • Strong understanding of solution lifecycle management, testing methodologies, deployment practices, and operational excellence.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, supportable technical solutions within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

  • Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance capabilities.

  • Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills.

  • Microsoft 365 certifications such as Enterprise Administrator Expert.

  • Experience supporting environments with more than 20,000 users.

  • Exchange Online administration experience.

  • Experience developing custom integrations and automation solutions using Microsoft Graph, Azure services, or related Microsoft cloud technologies.

  • Experience with DevOps practices, source control, CI/CD pipelines, or infrastructure-as-code concepts supporting Microsoft cloud platforms

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Trovata is the #1 digital platform to manage cash and liquidity. Built on Trovata’s industry-leading AWS cloud infrastructure and best-in-breed AI models, and a foundation of data connectivity and AI-ready infrastructure, Trovata gives treasury and finance teams real-time visibility, automated workflows, and the intelligence to lead. Our platform includes Trovata Cash, Trovata TMS, Trovata Data, and the MultiBank Connector — all designed to replace legacy systems with something built for how money moves today. We are backed by top-tier investors and integrated with the world's leading banks. The teams who choose Trovata don't just upgrade their tooling — they reposition treasury as a strategic function.

The company was founded by a longtime Controller-CFO with a vision for a better way and engineered by an experienced team from Capital One. We’re fortunate to be financially backed by a syndicate of banks, including J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo, and Capital One.

About the role

As a Solutions Engineer focused on Trovata TMS, you are the technical and functional center of gravity in our enterprise sales process. You translate complex treasury requirements into clear, compelling demonstrations of what Trovata's next-generation treasury operating system can do — and you do it with confidence, precision, and depth.

You will work directly with enterprise prospects, strategic partners, and existing customers — running discovery, building custom demos, leading technical workshops, and owning RFP responses. You sit at the intersection of sales, product, and implementation, and your work directly shapes how Trovata wins in the market.

What you'll do

Pre-sales & demos

  • Speak knowledgeably to Trovata’s underlying technical architecture — including our AWS-native cloud infrastructure and use of best-in-breed AI models — when engaging technical evaluators, IT, and security stakeholders during the sales cycle.
  • Lead discovery conversations to understand treasury workflows, pain points, bank connectivity requirements, and system architecture.
  • Build and deliver tailored product demonstrations of Trovata TMS — covering cash positioning, forecasting, payments, bank connectivity, and reporting.
  • Configure demo environments to reflect prospect-specific scenarios, including multi-entity structures, multi-currency requirements, and ERP integrations.
  • Present to audiences ranging from treasury analysts to CFOs and boards — adapting depth and framing to each.

Workshops & technical engagements

  • Design and facilitate pre-sales workshops to map customer processes to Trovata TMS capabilities.
  • Lead proof-of-concept (POC) engagements, defining success criteria, managing execution, and presenting outcomes.
  • Partner with implementation and customer success teams to ensure a seamless handoff from sales to onboarding.

RFPs & competitive positioning

  • Own RFP and RFI responses for Trovata TMS, coordinating inputs across product, legal, and security to produce accurate, compelling submissions on deadline.
  • Serve as the go-to voice on infrastructure, security, and AI-related RFP and security-questionnaire content — accurately representing Trovata’s AWS cloud architecture, data security posture, and use of best-in-breed AI models, in partnership with engineering and security teams.
  • Maintain and continuously improve a library of RFP content, standard responses, and security questionnaire answers.
  • Develop deep competitive fluency — articulating Trovata's differentiation versus legacy TMS vendors and emerging platforms clearly and credibly.

Cross-functional impact

  • Feed structured product feedback from the field into the product team — translating prospect requirements into actionable input.
  • Contribute to go-to-market materials including demo scripts, solution briefs, and battle cards.
  • Mentor and support Account Executives on technical qualification, solution framing, and deal strategy.

Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of modern cloud infrastructure and AI/ML systems — particularly AWS-native architectures and best-in-breed foundation models — sufficient to speak credibly with technical evaluators and security teams about how Trovata’s infrastructure and AI capabilities compare to legacy, on-premise TMS platforms.
  • Ability to articulate Trovata’s security, scalability, and AI-driven automation posture — including our AWS cloud architecture and industry-leading use of best-in-breed AI models — to IT, security, and infrastructure stakeholders during technical evaluations.
  • 5+ years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or treasury/fintech consulting — with direct exposure to treasury management systems or cash management platforms.
  • Hands-on familiarity with TMS platforms (e.g., Kyriba, FIS Integrity, ION, GTreasury, or similar) — enough to speak credibly about configuration, workflows, and limitations.
  • Deep understanding of treasury operations: cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank connectivity (SWIFT, BAI2, MT940), payments, and financial reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to run enterprise discovery, build tailored demos, and present complex solutions to senior financial stakeholders.
  • Strong RFP writing and project management skills — comfortable owning multi-workstream submissions under tight timelines.
  • Clear, confident communication — written and verbal — with the ability to simplify technical depth without losing precision.

Nice to have

  • Experience with ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) in a treasury or finance context.
  • Familiarity with API-based bank connectivity and financial data normalization.
  • Background in fintech, banking technology, or enterprise SaaS sales engineering.
  • CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) designation or equivalent treasury finance credential.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) or enterprise AI/ML platforms, including exposure to leading foundation models and responsible AI governance practices.

Benefits

  • Compensations - Base salary of $129,000–$187,500, plus a 20% OTC (target on-target earnings of approximately $155,000–$225,000). Final compensation within this range may be determined by factors including relevant experience, qualifications and location.

Team members have the opportunity to support a wide variety of medical specialties while working alongside healthcare professionals dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

As the company continues expanding nationwide, it is growing its remote healthcare operations team to support an increasing number of physicians and medical practices across the U.S.

We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Bilingual Medical Admin (English/Spanish) to join a growing healthcare support team.

In this role, you'll provide essential administrative support to U.S.-based medical practices by managing patient records, verifying insurance eligibility, coordinating prior authorizations, supporting prescription workflows, maintaining provider credentialing documentation, and ensuring the accuracy and compliance of medical records.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, values organization and accuracy, and is passionate about providing exceptional administrative support that contributes to quality patient care.

Patient Administration & Medical Records

Medication & Prescription Support

Credentialing & Provider Support

Administrative Support

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-time, 30 hours per week Schedule: PST-aligned schedule with some evening and weekend coverage Rate: USD $ 845.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time, 30 hours per week

Schedule: PST-aligned schedule with some evening and weekend coverage

Rate: USD $ 845.00 to $ 1,105.00 per month

About the Company

Our client is an established Canadian property management company overseeing approximately 25 furnished rental properties. The company manages a combination of short-term, mid-term, and long-term accommodations across multiple locations.

They are seeking an experienced Senior Short-Term Rental Manager to take ownership of the daily operations of six to seven properties transitioning to nightly vacation rentals. The successful candidate must already understand Airbnb operations and be capable of managing listings, reservations, guest communications, and property coordination without extensive training.

Role Overview

The Senior Short-Term Rental Manager will oversee the guest experience and operational requirements of the assigned properties, from initial inquiries through check-out. This person will work closely with the company’s existing Virtual Assistant during onboarding before independently managing the assigned portfolio.

The position requires someone with substantial hands-on experience managing multiple Airbnb properties. Experience limited to Airbnb customer service or one or two personally owned listings will not be sufficient for this senior-level position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple short-term rental listings across Airbnb and VRBO.
  • Create, launch, update, and optimize property listings, including descriptions, amenities, photos, house rules, and availability.
  • Handle guest communications from inquiry and booking through check-in, the duration of the stay, and check-out.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest questions, concerns, access issues, and urgent requests.
  • Maintain reservation calendars and ensure booking information remains accurate across platforms.
  • Coordinate cleaners, turnovers, maintenance concerns, and other property-related requirements.
  • Review property information and become familiar with each unit’s amenities, access instructions, building details, emergency information, and operating procedures.
  • Ensure guests receive accurate check-in instructions, property information, and follow-up support.
  • Assist with launching the remaining properties as they receive their short-term rental licences and professional photos.
  • Work closely with the existing Virtual Assistant and company leadership during the initial onboarding and knowledge-transfer period.
  • Follow established standard operating procedures while identifying opportunities to improve guest communication and rental operations.
  • Support dynamic pricing and revenue-management activities when experienced with PriceLabs or similar platforms.
  • Perform light bookkeeping tasks in QuickBooks when qualified, such as categorizing property-related purchases, matching credit card transactions, and organizing expenses by unit.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Strong, recent, and hands-on experience managing Airbnb properties.
  • Experience managing multiple short-term or vacation rental listings simultaneously.
  • Experience using both Airbnb and VRBO.
  • Previous experience working for a property management, hospitality, or vacation rental company.
  • Comprehensive understanding of the Airbnb guest journey, platform rules, listing management, reservations, and issue resolution.
  • Ability to manage guest communications independently without requiring training on Airbnb fundamentals.
  • Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with guests.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Ability to handle urgent concerns calmly and make sound operational decisions.
  • Comfortable working independently while coordinating with cleaners, contractors, and internal team members.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Guesty, Hospitable, or another property management system.
  • Experience with PriceLabs or similar dynamic-pricing software.
  • QuickBooks or light bookkeeping experience.
  • Experience launching new short-term rental listings.
  • Familiarity with Canadian holidays, seasonal pricing, and vacation-rental booking patterns.

Schedule Expectations

The selected candidate will initially overlap with the existing Virtual Assistant to complete training and property handovers. After onboarding, the schedule will provide complementary coverage and may include afternoon or evening PST hours and allocated weekend hours to support guests outside the existing team member’s schedule.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a proactive and experienced short-term rental professional who understands that successful property management requires more than responding to messages. They take ownership of the guest experience, anticipate operational issues, maintain accurate information, and ensure that bookings and turnovers run smoothly without constant direction.

Benefits

  • Opportunities for growth and advancement
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Maxicare HMO after completing the three-month probationary period

Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • Lead and shape the QA function at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world's leading insurers
  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Own quality strategy for a fast-growing product suite, with a direct line to the Head of QA and real influence over how we build

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

What You Will Do

Strategy, Process & Governance

  • Provide full oversight of the testing lifecycle across multiple teams and projects, defining and enforcing QA processes and standardizing tools, environments, and test coverage organization-wide
  • Establish and continuously refine QA processes, procedures, and standards for testing products before they go to market
  • Ensure scalable test infrastructure, and extend our testing capability into advanced domains including performance, security, and compliance testing
  • Identify systemic quality gaps and cross-team risks, run trend analysis on quality metrics, and anticipate issues that could affect release stability or timelines
  • Evaluate and resolve organizational blockers in QA workflows, balancing trade-offs and delivery timelines while protecting stakeholder satisfaction

Team Leadership

jobs.excerpt: GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles.
jobs.description:
GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We care about craftsmanship, collaboration, and shipping work we’re proud to put our names on. If you love building environments and believable spaces we’d like to meet you. Our headquarters is based in Orlando, FL!

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice
Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are seeking a Lighting Artist to create high-quality real-time lighting and help support the execution of lighting work across GameSim projects.

This is a hands-on production role with opportunities to take on project-level leadership responsibilities. In addition to completing assigned lighting work, you may help coordinate tasks, review the work of other artists, provide constructive feedback, and ensure scenes meet the visual and technical quality bar established by Art Direction and the client.

You will collaborate with Art Directors, Environment Artists, Technical Artists, VFX Artists, Designers, Engineers, Producers, clients, and partner studios to translate creative direction into lighting solutions that support mood, gameplay readability, environmental storytelling, and performance.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Develop a clear understanding of the project’s visual direction, lighting pipeline, gameplay requirements, technical constraints, and production schedule.
  • Build effective working relationships with Art Direction, Production, Technical Art, Environment Art, Design, and other project disciplines.
  • Create polished lighting work that meets the project’s established visual and technical quality bar.
  • Take ownership of lighting for assigned scenes, environments, sequences, or gameplay areas.
  • Provide useful feedback and support to other artists when asked to review or coordinate lighting work.
  • Identify artistic, technical, or production risks early and communicate them to the appropriate project leads.
  • Deliver assigned work on schedule and respond effectively to internal and client feedback.

Responsibilities

Lighting Creation and Execution

  • Create high-quality real-time lighting for gameplay environments, levels, cinematics, characters, and interactive sequences.
  • Translate art direction, concept art, reference material, gameplay requirements, narrative goals, and client feedback into effective lighting solutions.
  • Use lighting to establish mood, atmosphere, visual hierarchy, environmental storytelling, and player focus.
  • Ensure lighting supports gameplay readability, navigation, combat visibility, character presentation, and important interactive elements.
  • Develop and refine exposure, color, contrast, fog, atmosphere, reflections, shadows, emissive response, color grading, and post-processing.
  • Create lighting for a range of visual styles, including realistic, stylized, cinematic, and highly art-directed projects.
  • Maintain visual consistency across related environments, gameplay spaces, sequences, times of day, and lighting conditions.
  • Bring assigned scenes from initial lighting setup through final polish.
  • Respond to feedback from Art Direction, project leadership, and clients in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensure completed work meets project requirements for quality, performance, organization, and delivery.

Leadership and Quality Support

  • Help oversee lighting work for an assigned scene, group of scenes, feature, or milestone when requested by project leadership.
  • Review the work of other lighting artists or multidisciplinary artists contributing to lighting.
  • Provide clear, respectful, and actionable feedback through written notes, live reviews, reference images, paintovers, or in-engine examples.
  • Help ensure lighting work follows approved visual targets, technical standards, and project requirements.
  • Communicate expected outcomes, priorities, and quality standards to artists working within an assigned area.
  • Monitor the visual progress of assigned lighting work and identify scenes that may require additional revision or support.
  • Confirm that feedback has been addressed before work is submitted for senior, Art Director, or client review.
  • Support junior or less-experienced artists with lighting fundamentals, engine workflows, scene organization, optimization, and production practices.
  • Lead by example through reliable execution, clear communication, constructive collaboration, and professional conduct.
  • Escalate unresolved quality, schedule, scope, or technical concerns to the appropriate senior artist, Art Director, or Producer.

Planning and Production Support

  • Work with Art Direction and Production to understand lighting priorities, tasks, estimates, and milestone expectations.
  • Help break lighting goals into clear and manageable production tasks.
  • Provide progress updates and communicate when assigned work is at risk of missing quality, technical, or scheduling requirements.
  • Participate in daily reviews, art reviews, milestone evaluations, and planning discussions.
  • Help prepare lighting work for internal reviews, client presentations, milestone submissions, and final delivery.
  • Balance hands-on production responsibilities with review, coordination, troubleshooting, and team support.
  • Adjust priorities when creative direction, technical requirements, production scope, or client feedback changes.
  • Maintain accurate task status and documentation using the project’s production-management tools.

Technical and Pipeline Responsibilities

  • Work with Technical Art and Engineering to ensure lighting is visually effective, technically stable, and appropriate for the target platform.
  • Follow established budgets for dynamic lights, shadows, volumetrics, reflections, global illumination, memory, and scalability.
  • Identify and help resolve issues involving exposure, shadow artifacts, light leaking, reflections, volumetrics, bake quality, material response, and post-processing.
  • Use dynamic, baked, stationary, or hybrid lighting approaches according to the project’s established pipeline.
  • Profile assigned lighting work and make informed visual adjustments to meet performance requirements.
  • Validate lighting across relevant gameplay cameras, display settings, hardware targets, times of day, weather states, and scalability levels.
  • Follow project standards for scene organization, naming conventions, source control, documentation, and asset integration.
  • Contribute to reusable lighting setups, templates, documentation, validation processes, and team best practices.
  • Identify workflow problems and communicate potential improvements to senior artists, Technical Art, or project leadership.

Cross-Discipline Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Environment Art to ensure geometry, materials, composition, and set dressing support the intended lighting.
  • Partner with VFX to integrate fog, particles, weather, fire, emissive effects, and atmospheric elements.
  • Work with Design to ensure lighting supports navigation, player guidance, combat readability, objectives, and interactive systems.
  • Coordinate with Character Art and Animation to maintain readable and appealing character presentation.
  • Support cinematic lighting needs involving shot composition, continuity, exposure, character lighting, and narrative focus.
  • Communicate artistic and technical concerns clearly to both creative and non-creative stakeholders.
  • Work effectively with distributed teams, partner studios, external vendors, and clients across different time zones.

Requirements

  • Professional experience creating lighting for games, real-time projects, animation, visualization, or a closely related field.
  • A portfolio or reel demonstrating strong real-time lighting work.
  • Strong understanding of lighting fundamentals, including value, color, contrast, composition, visual hierarchy, atmosphere, exposure, shadow, and material response.
  • Experience lighting gameplay environments or interactive real-time scenes.
  • Understanding of how lighting supports mood, gameplay readability, navigation, environmental storytelling, and player focus.
  • Professional experience using Unreal Engine or another modern real-time engine.
  • Experience with dynamic or baked lighting, global illumination, reflections, volumetrics, exposure, color grading, and post-processing.
  • Working knowledge of physically based rendering and material response.
  • Understanding of basic lighting optimization, including light cost, shadows, volumetrics, reflections, scalability, and platform constraints.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned scenes and follow them through review and completion.
  • Ability to receive, interpret, and implement artistic and technical feedback.
  • Experience reviewing artwork or providing constructive feedback to teammates.
  • Ability to identify work that does not meet an established quality target and communicate practical improvements.
  • Ability to balance visual quality, technical requirements, production scope, and schedule.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to organize priorities, communicate risks, and follow work through to completion.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple game-development disciplines.
  • Ability to adapt to different projects, visual styles, engines, pipelines, platforms, and client expectations.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team.

Tools and Technical Experience

Candidates should have experience with a professional real-time lighting toolset. This may include:

  • Unreal Engine 5 or another modern real-time engine
  • Lumen or comparable real-time global-illumination systems
  • GPU Lightmass, CPU Lightmass, or comparable baked-lighting systems
  • Real-time profiling, visualization, and debugging tools
  • Photoshop or comparable image-editing software
  • DaVinci Resolve, Nuke, After Effects, or comparable color and compositing tools
  • Maya, Blender, 3ds Max, or another 3D content-creation package
  • Perforce or another production source-control system
  • Jira, Confluence, Miro, or comparable planning and documentation tools

Expertise with every listed application is not required. We are primarily interested in candidates who demonstrate strong lighting fundamentals, sound production judgment, adaptability, and the ability to learn project-specific tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in co-development, outsourcing, consulting, or work-for-hire game production.
  • Experience contributing to a shipped PC or console title.
  • Experience working across realistic and stylized visual pipelines.
  • Previous experience acting as a lighting point person, task coordinator, reviewer, or feature owner.
  • Experience guiding junior artists or supporting teammates without formal management authority.
  • Experience working with remote teams, partner studios, or external vendors.
  • Experience owning lighting for a level, environment, sequence, or gameplay feature.
  • Knowledge of Unreal Engine systems such as Lumen, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, volumetric fog, reflection systems, exposure controls, post-process volumes, and scalability settings.
  • Experience with dynamic time-of-day systems, weather systems, destructible environments, or changing gameplay states.
  • Experience lighting cinematics, characters, dialogue scenes, or scripted sequences.
  • Knowledge of cinematography, photography, film lighting, camera exposure, and color theory.
  • Familiarity with HDR displays, tone mapping, calibration, or accessibility considerations.
  • Familiarity with rendering pipelines, shader behavior, and material development.
  • Familiarity with Blueprints, Python, editor scripting, automation, or technical-art workflows.
  • Experience creating lighting documentation, templates, benchmark scenes, or review materials.

Portfolio Requirements

Your portfolio or reel should demonstrate:

  • Strong real-time lighting with effective composition, mood, color, contrast, readability, atmosphere, and scene cohesion.
  • Work presented in a commercial, proprietary, or modern real-time engine.
  • Clear explanations of your individual contribution, responsibilities, workflow, and production decisions.
  • Gameplay lighting that guides attention, supports navigation, and reinforces the intended player experience.
  • Effective integration between lighting, environments, materials, VFX, atmosphere, characters, and post-processing.
  • An understanding of optimization, scalability, technical limitations, and production constraints.
  • Examples showing ownership of lighting from initial setup through final delivery.
  • The ability to work from concept art, reference, environment blockouts, narrative direction, gameplay requirements, or developing creative direction.
  • Adaptability across different projects, genres, visual styles, or lighting conditions.

We also encourage applicants to include:

  • Day and night treatments of the same environment.
  • Dynamic and baked lighting examples.
  • Lighting created for different gameplay states, weather conditions, or times of day.
  • Before-and-after comparisons showing how lighting improved readability, mood, composition, or performance.
  • Examples of work reviewed or coordinated under your guidance, with your responsibilities clearly explained.
  • Lighting guides, reference boards, benchmark scenes, review notes, documentation, or templates created for teammates.

Please clearly identify your individual contribution to collaborative work.

How to Apply

A resume and portfolio or reel link are required.

Please include shipped-game credits or comparable professional project experience where applicable. Candidates may be asked to participate in a portfolio review, technical discussion, leadership interview, or art assessment as part of the selection process.

This position is currently open to candidates residing in the following Canada Provinces: Ontario or British Columbia.

Salary Range: $65,000 CAD to $70,000 CAD

What's in it for you?

  • Opportunity to work on different projects
  • 3 weeks of paid leave
  • Benefits package including medical, dental and vision
  • Sick Leave
  • Disability Coverage
  • Corporate holidays
  • Professional Development

GameSim is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, and alignment with the role.

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at .

jobs.title: Senior Channel Sales Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Say hello to opportunities. If you’re looking to be part of what’s next in communication, you’re in the right place.
jobs.description:
Say hello to opportunities.

If you’re looking to be part of what’s next in communication, you’re in the right place.

At RingCentral, we believe the best customer experiences happen when humans and AI work together. Our agentic voice AI portfolio—AIR, AVA, and ACE—brings together automation, assistance, and insights across the entire conversation lifecycle. The result? More seamless, intelligent experiences for businesses everywhere.

With $2.5B+ in ARR and $250M invested in R&D annually, we’re building the future of AI-powered business communications.

This is where you and your skills come in. We’re currently looking for:a Sales Engineer to be the technical voice and interface of our Partner Sales & Business Development Team. In this role, you will ensure that the solutions we sell and develop are both technically sound and commercially viable, whilst helping to build long-term trust with our partners and customers.

The Sales Engineer is expected to have industry knowledge in the areas of UC, CX / Contact Centre, AI, Language Models, Mobility and IMS Integration, and a comprehensive understanding of API Concepts.

An in-depth knowledge of RingCentral’s UC & Customer Experience Portfolio, including RingCX OEM partners, would also be of benefit.

Job Responsibilities:

This is a primarily a customer facing role, whose objective is to work alongside our Sales & Business Development teams to drive incremental revenue from our existing partners, and to collaborate in identifying new business partners and revenue streams in different regions and market segments.

The Sales Engineer is accountable for driving technical trust, ensuring solution-fit, and enabling sales success by delivering clear, credible, and consultative engagements with both partners and customers throughout the customer lifecycle.

Solutions would be based on our current portfolio, plus the ability to innovate where needed, to help differentiate RingCentral in the marketplace.

The Sales Engineer would work with the Sales Engineering Leadership team, the Sales Executives, and the RingCentral Product Teams, to co-ordinate the development and delivery of new services and propositions.

  • Co-ordinate and lead discovery sessions with partners and customers, to identify their business requirements and objectives

  • Engage in business-led conversations with customers and partners to articulate the benefits that the RingCentral EX/CX Portfolio of services will provide, e.g. Revenue Generation Opportunities via Cross Sell / Upsell, Operational Efficiency, and Cost Savings via Automation.

  • Develop and cultivate relationships with partners, customers, sales and support teams, having the ability to flex your style within different audiences.

  • Ability to provide technical leadership to the Sales & Partner Account teams.

  • Become a trusted advisor in the Sales and Pre-Sales community, providing world-class operational and technical support when needed.

  • Help create repeatable Sales Support collateral and content, from Sales Playbooks, Verticalized Demonstrations, TCO Tools, Promotions and Campaigns.

  • Provide industry, technical, and product insight to partners and customers to deliver maximum value for the RingCentral proposition.

People Leadership: Proven success leading, developing, and coaching high-performing teams, while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous growth.

Cross-Functional Influence: Ability to partner effectively with Sales, Ad Operations, Advertising Operations, Analytics, and other stakeholders to align strategies and drive business results.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate business objectives, advertiser needs, and market dynamics into scalable media, audience, and revenue strategies.

Relationship Management: Proven ability to build credibility and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners while influencing decisions across multiple levels of the organization.

Project & Process Management: Ability to establish scalable processes, manage competing priorities, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex media, audience, and revenue concepts to diverse audiences.

Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, along with experience using advertising platforms such as GAM, DV360, Meta, Nielsen, Comscore, and CRM tools such as Salesforce.

Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, navigate ambiguity, and develop practical solutions that balance advertiser needs, operational requirements, and business goals.

Execution Excellence: Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence, ensuring media plans, forecasts, pricing strategies, and campaigns are executed accurately and effectively.

Who You Are

  • Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply.

  • 8-10 years of Media Planning experience within a digital media environment. 2-3 years of experience in Yield Management.

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts

  • Performance-based incentives

  • Annual merit review

  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

BUILD YOUR CAREER HERE

Supply Chain alliance helps organizations unlock value by applying new thinking, state-of-the-art tools and innovative approaches to their businesses. From leadership and advisory support and end-to-end value chain planning to network and operation optimization, we partner with our customers to conceive what’s possible, set the right course, and take action. Let us help you reimagine your supply chain.

The Business Analyst is a key member of the Client Delivery Team and works closely with Practice Leaders, Engagement Managers, and Consulting Partners to deliver value-add solutions to Supply Chain Alliance Ltd.’s clients. This role operates as an analytical business partner to Client Delivery leadership, independently structuring analytical workstreams and translating complex data into decision-ready recommendations that drive measurable outcomes. The role includes gathering of business requirements, in-depth data analysis, preparation of client workshops, development of client specific recommendations/improvements, implementation of new initiatives, and supporting operational start-up or turnaround activities. The Analyst will also be confident in presenting results to clients and implementing recommendations in collaboration with other team members.

The Analyst reports to the Practice Leader, Client Delivery.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather and analyze requirements, and work collaboratively with the client delivery team using Supply Chain Alliance Ltd.’s methodologies to develop impactful recommendations and solutions

  • Document client business requirements and recommend and implement processes and best practices
  • Analyze and diagnose the current state, conduct root cause analysis, and identify improvement opportunities
  • Evaluate and present information that will facilitate timely decision-making that summarize findings and recommendations
  • Integrate, cleanse, and synthesize data to develop actionable insights

  • Facilitate workshops and stakeholder sessions

  • Relevant experience and/or exposure to supply chain and logistics assessments, logistics facility design and process optimization, distribution network design, TL/LTL/parcel/intermodal transportation, planning and inventory management, supply chain software, third party logistics, etc.

  • 15 working days of paid vacation plus 5 additional paid sick days;

  • Annual medical insurance reimbursement after the trial period (up to 500 USD gross);

  • Up to 10 paid public holidays each year;

  • Continuous learning through language courses, internal training programs, and Udemy access;

  • Personalized Professional Development Plan (PDP), transparent career paths, and mentorship programs;

  • Business travel reimbursement in line with company policy;

  • Flexible remote work.

jobs.description:
About IMG Academy IMG Academy is the world’s leading sports education brand, providing a holistic education model that empowers student-athletes to win their future while preparing them for college and for life. IMG Academy has been nationally recognized by organizations including Sports Business Journal, USA Today, and the Best and Brightest Companies to Work For for its workplace culture, innovation, and commitment to developing people both on and off the field.

IMG Academy provides growth opportunities for student-athletes and partners through an innovative suite of on-campus and online experiences:

  • Boarding school and camps, delivered on a state-of-the-art campus in Bradenton, Florida
  • Online coaching through IMG Academy+, focused on personal development through the lens of sport and performance
  • Online college recruiting through NCSA College Recruiting and SportsRecruits, providing industry-leading recruiting education, tools, and access to a network of more than 40,000 college coaches for student-athletes, families, club coaches, and event operators
  • Elevate by IMG Academy, a performance and personal development solution that delivers mindset, leadership, and wellbeing programming to schools, colleges, and organizations through a combination of digital content and immersive experiences

Position Summary As the Vice President, Data, you will lead transformative initiatives across omnichannel customer technology, enterprise data, analytics, and data science. Reporting directly to the SVP of Product, Data & Commercial Technology, this role is responsible for driving customer engagement, revenue growth, operational efficiency, and digital transformation across a multi-brand enterprise serving both B2B and B2C customers. The VP owns the strategy, execution, and evolution of the enterprise data roadmap, overseeing data infrastructure, business intelligence, analytics, and data science capabilities that enable personalized customer experiences, data-driven decision-making, and scalable business growth. This leader will also build, develop, and inspire high-performing teams while fostering a culture of innovation and engineering excellence.

You will lead two key functions:

  • Data Engineering & Business Intelligence: Responsible for modernizing enterprise data infrastructure, data platforms, governance, and business intelligence engineering.
  • Data Science & Analytics: Responsible for advanced analytics, machine learning, and applied data science to improve customer acquisition, onboarding, retention, engagement, and overall business performance.

You have a proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives from strategy through execution. You excel at delivering enterprise-wide programs aligned with C-suite priorities, driving measurable business outcomes while managing long-term initiatives across internal and external stakeholders. This is a highly collaborative leadership role, partnering closely with the Chief Commercial Officer, Business Unit COOs, SVP of Product & Design, SVP of Product Engineering, executive leadership, board members, and cross-functional teams to translate strategic business objectives into scalable technology solutions and deliver an integrated commercial, product, and customer experience strategy. You are a strategic, business-minded leader who builds high-performing organizations, leads through change, and consistently delivers results. You foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and empowered teams while maintaining a strong focus on business outcomes, innovation, and engineering excellence.

Position Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Define and execute a comprehensive technology strategy for commercial systems, data infrastructure, and customer engagement platforms.
  • Build the next-generation customer engagement "Engine,” delivering measurable improvements in customer acquisition, retention, ARPU, and EBITDA.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders from the board to practitioner- level to align technology initiatives with business objectives driving digital transformation.
  • Integrate data functions, unifying data infrastructure, creating self-service BI capacity, and optimizing teams to align data and analytics efforts with commercial, product, and CX goals.
  • Champion the shift to an integrated commercial and product strategy by enabling self- service for functional teams and delivering more high-value algorithmic work using AI/ML.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Build and scale a high-performing team of ~25 FTEs and consultants, including resources for Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science.
  • Lead the transformation of the Data organization into a value-driven (vs. technology-driven) model supporting commercial, digital product, and customer experience domains.
  • Guide the evolution of the team from baseline support to a mature omnichannel enablement organization leveraging data and insights to drive revenue, EBITDA and NPS.
  • Develop a leadership layer across Data and Engine functions through internal advancement, role re-definition, and strategic hiring to create scale and accountability for stakeholders.
  • Cultivate a culture of value delivery, transparency, and accountability, while driving iterative improvement, greater operational rigor and prioritization of high-value ML innovation work.

Technology Leadership

  • Direct the modernization of enterprise-wide data infrastructure, BI, analytics and data science tools, migrating, consolidating and standardizing tools and vendors.
  • Ensure alignment between BI, analytics, and Data Science initiatives and business goals, leveraging continuous testing and optimization to enhance customer and enterprise value.
  • Ensure alignment between commercial technology initiatives and customer-facing product roadmap, software development and integration initiatives.
  • Partner with external vendors including Salesforce, AWS, and implementation partners, to deliver cost-effective solutions while maintaining strategic direction and execution quality.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Chief Commercial Officer, COO for Online, COO for Campus, and SVP Product to ensure seamless execution of commercial technology strategies.
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing and partner leadership to align technology with operational goals, while navigating resistance and driving adoption.
  • Present strategies and outcomes to executive leadership and the Board, leveraging data and analysis to build consensus and drive decisions.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • 15+ years progressive tech leadership experience with 7+ years in senior management roles.
  • Experience leading large-scale, full-lifecycle digital transformation initiatives and platform consolidations in B2B and B2C settings, managing internal teams and external partners.
  • Experience merging disparate systems and teams, with a focus on enabling personalized customer experiences for omnichannel, multi-product customer acquisition and retention.
  • Proven track-record leading and executing technology and data-specific transformation initiatives delivering compelling measurable impact.
  • Senior-level leadership background across high-growth entrepreneurial environments and companies undergoing transformational changes in corporate development.
  • Hands-on experience leading teams in creating business leverage (Revenue, EBITDA, NPS) using commercial technology and customer engagement platforms to grow and scale these capabilities on a strategic basis.
  • Track record building and scaling high-performing technical and business-facing teams
  • Deep understanding of the modern data stack and its deployment for BI, Analytics and Data Science applications in commercial and product use cases, with a track record of successful implementations at scale.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with boards, C-level executives and cross-functional implementation teams, navigating resistance and generating buy-in from stakeholders
  • Superior communication skills, with an emphasis on brevity, clarity, and data-driven persuasion.
  • Industry experience in education, B2C, or consumer-facing products/services required.

Background Requirements:

  • Requires a background check upon offer

Benefits:

As a full-time member of our team, you will enjoy a comprehensive offering listed below. Connect with your talent acquisition specialist to learn more about benefits for our part-time roles.

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision
  • Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account options
  • 401k with an Employer Match
  • Short Term and Long Term Disability
  • Group and Supplemental Life & AD&D
  • Gym Discount Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • Wellbeing Program
  • and more!

Don’t meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Remote Educational ASL Interpreter (Full-Time, School-Based)
Location: Remote (Supporting a New Mexico School District)
Schedule: Monday-Friday, approximately 7.5 hours per day

Start Date: Mid-August

We are seeking a qualified Educational ASL Interpreter to provide remote interpretation services for students in a New Mexico school district. This is a full-time, school-based role supporting student access and communication during the school day.

Position Overview

The Educational ASL Interpreter will work remotely to support Deaf or Hard of Hearing students by providing American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation in instructional and school-related settings. This role plays a critical part in ensuring equitable access to curriculum and school activities.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Provide accurate, real-time ASL interpretation for classroom instruction and school activities
  • Support student communication with teachers, peers, and school staff
  • Maintain confidentiality and adhere to FERPA and school district guidelines
  • Collaborate with school staff and special education teams as needed
  • Participate in required meetings or check-ins related to student support

Qualifications

  • Fluency in American Sign Language (ASL)
  • Prior experience as an educational or school-based interpreter preferred
  • Familiarity with K–12 educational settings
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet connection and appropriate technology for remote interpreting
  • Active New Mexico state board ASL interpreter license (or willingness to obtain)
  • Active New Mexico Public Education Department (PED) certification (or willingness to obtain)

Benefits

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote, school-based work
  • Consistent, predictable schedule
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on student access and learning
  • Supportive, collaborative team environment
  • Competitive pay

  • Schedule delay analysis

  • Loss of labour productivity analysis

  • Change in scope assessments

  • Review and analysis of change orders

  • Analysis of labour, equipment, and material costs

  • Calculation of escalated material and/or labour costs

  • Analysis of unabsorbed home office overhead

  • Review and organisation of project documents

  • Development of work product, draft memos, and reports

  • Travel as needed to visit client project sites and offices

  • Experience in engineering and construction industry, preferably with knowledge and experience of construction claims

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Accounting, or Engineering

  • Microsoft Office – intermediate to advanced skills preferred

  • Bluebeam or other PDF management software

About Burq

Burq started with an ambitious mission: to turn the complex process of offering delivery into a simple, turnkey solution. It’s a big mission, and now we want you to join us in making it even bigger. 🚀

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Fast Company’s Best Workplaces for Innovators and a 2025 Inc. Magazine Power Partner, awards that highlight how we’re redefining the future of logistics while empowering our partners to grow.

Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors like Village Global, the fund whose investors include Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg, Reid Hoffman, and Sara Blakely, we’ve built a world-class team across the globe.

We operate at scale but remain small enough for every person to have a massive impact. There’s a lot of important work ahead, and joining Burq means the opportunity to grow faster than ever while doing the most meaningful work of your career.

Here’s a quick overview of what you will be doing:

The Role

We're looking for a VP of Finance to take Burq's finance and operations to the next level. We have a foundation in place — the systems, partners, and core operations that keep the business running. What we need now is a leader who can scale it into a strategic engine for the company: sharper planning, real financial rigor, and the operational muscle to support our next phase of growth.

This is not a role for someone who just manages the books. You'll be a true partner to the founders — owning how we plan, how we allocate capital, how we price and grow revenue, and how we run the company operationally. You're equally comfortable building the first model in a spreadsheet yourself and presenting it to the board: a builder, not just a manager. You'll bring a strong operational pulse across finance, revenue, and G&A, and you'll help us grow the entire business. High ownership, high leverage, direct line to every decision that matters.

What You'll Do

Financial Strategy & Planning

  • Own budgeting, forecasting, and a rolling financial model grounded in actual results
  • Deliver real-time visibility into burn, runway, and cash
  • Install capital-allocation discipline: clear ROI on every team, initiative, and investment
  • Produce board-grade financial reporting, analysis, and hygiene

Revenue Strategy & Operations

  • Own and shape our revenue strategy end to end — pricing, packaging, and monetization
  • Build the upsell and expansion motion
  • Model the unit economics and metrics that define a marketplace — take rate, contribution margin per delivery, gross margin, CAC:LTV, net revenue retention, and burn multiple
  • Partner with Go-to-Market on deal-level pricing for complex enterprise opportunities, and stand up revenue forecasting and operating rigor

Accounting, Financial Operations, & Capital Strategy

  • Scale our accounting operations — close, controls, and systems — into a reliable, in-house-caliber function
  • Establish financial controls, policies, and audit readiness
  • Lead financial preparation - model, data room, narrative, and diligence
  • Own investor and board relationships, reporting, and materials alongside the co-founders
  • Own the cap table, scenario and dilution modeling, and capital planning

Operations, People & Legal

  • Provide operational leadership across G&A — own or partner closely on People/HR and Legal as we scale
  • Build the systems, processes, and team that let the company grow efficiently
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the founders on company-wide operational decisions

Requirements

  • 10+ years across finance and operations with senior leadership experience — VP of Finance, Head of Finance & Operations, or CFO-track at a high-growth startup
  • A hands-on player-coach — you build the model, the forecast, and the board deck yourself before you have a team to delegate to, and you're comfortable in the details of the ledger
  • Has led or been central to growth fundraising — modeling, diligence, and investor/board management
  • Command of marketplace / usage-based accounting — gross-vs-net revenue treatment, revenue recognition, high-volume transaction reconciliation, and contractor/provider payouts
  • Built and scaled an FP&A function and matured finance operations into a rigorous, reliable engine
  • Strong command of unit economics and the metrics that define a marketplace — take rate, contribution margin, CAC:LTV, net revenue retention, burn multiple — plus revenue strategy (pricing, packaging, expansion)
  • Operational breadth — comfortable owning or partnering across HR, Legal, and broader G&A
  • Deep accounting fluency (CPA or equivalent experience a plus), with a track record of clean, timely closes and sound controls
  • A genuine strategic partner to founders who turns numbers into company-building decisions
  • Bonus: experience in logistics, delivery, supply chain, or another operations-heavy marketplace

Location

This is a fully remote role, open to candidates based in the United States and Canada, with a few in-person offsites throughout the year.

Benefits

Investing in you 🙏

  • Competitive salary, stock options, and performance-based bonuses
  • Fully remote
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental insurance

jobs.description:
Nearfield Instruments (NFI) is a fast-growing scale-up high-tech company. We design, develop, integrate, market and service advanced metrology machines. Our machines enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers – to increase the production yields, and thus, functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics.

Founded in 2016, we bring together the most creative minds (approx. 320 employees) in science and technology and develop a one-of-a-kind, revolutionary high throughput Scanning Probe Microscopy system.

About the job

Senior application engineer in Lithography and Optical Imaging with a strong background in lithography, EUV, and scanner performance optimization. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in optical imaging and lithography physics to advance our metrology and process control solutions.

What will you be doing?

  • Develop and optimize optical imaging models and techniques for use in advanced metrology and inspection.

  • Translate scanner performance knowledge (CDU, focus, overlay, aberrations, imaging limits) into innovative process control solutions.

  • Apply expertise in (High-NA) EUV mask characterization, including 3D feature metrology (absorber CD, sidewall angle, height) and resist behavior under EUV and out-of-band light exposure.

  • Advance methods such as scatterometry and computational imaging to push the limits of in-line process control.

  • Collaborate with system architects, AFM/imaging experts, and software engineers to integrate imaging innovations into our commercial systems.

  • Work with leading global semiconductor fabs to validate and deploy solutions in high-volume manufacturing environments.

What do we require from you?

  • PhD or MSc in Physics, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

  • Deep expertise in optical imaging, EUV lithography, and scanner performance optimization.

  • Proven experience in EUV mask, scatterometry, and resist characterization.

  • Ability to bridge lithography knowledge with metrology and process control applications.

  • 5+ years of industry or advanced academic research experience in semiconductor lithography, optical metrology, or related domains.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across disciplines in a fast-paced R&D environment.

jobs.title: Commercial Lead (Biz Dev & Sales)
jobs.excerpt: Red Sky has been building technology companies since 2006.
jobs.description:
Red Sky has been building technology companies since 2006. We validate ideas, build MVPs, recruit key teams and help turn ambitious concepts into real businesses. Now, we are opening more of these capabilities to external partners. We are looking for a

Commercial Lead who will take ownership of the entire sales journey - from identifying the right markets and opening conversations to understanding complex business needs, shaping the right solution and closing the deal. This is not a role for someone waiting for a list of warm leads. We are looking for a builder and someone who can create opportunities where there is no obvious pipeline yet.

Your mission

Goal: build a predictable, repeatable and scalable sales engine for Red Sky's services - and use it to consistently generate new business and accelerate our commercial growth. You will work directly with the people responsible for product development, technology, recruitment, and venture building. Together, we will identify where Red Sky can create the most value - and you will turn that value into business. You will own the process from the first signal to signing the contract.

You will

  • identify the most promising customer segments and commercial opportunities,

  • build and continuously improve our target account strategy,

  • create your own pipeline through high-quality outbound, networking, partnerships and creative prospecting,

  • run discovery calls and uncover the real business problem behind the initial request,

  • translate client needs into a clear scope of cooperation together with our internal experts,

  • create and present commercial proposals,

  • negotiate terms and lead opportunities through to signed contracts,

  • develop existing accounts and identify opportunities for further cooperation,

  • build and manage the sales pipeline, CRM discipline, forecasting and reporting,

  • test new sales channels, partnerships, messages and market segments,

  • bring market feedback back to the team and influence how our services evolve.

Requirements

You may be a strong fit if you

  • have proven experience selling B2B services such as software development, product development, technology consulting, tech-recruitment, professional services or similar,

  • know how to sell consultatively and navigate conversations where the client does not yet have a perfectly defined brief,

  • understand how to move from discovery to proposal, negotiation and closing and have personally generated pipeline rather than relying exclusively on inbound leads,

  • are comfortable working with multiple service lines and creating tailored commercial propositions,

  • think in terms of pipeline, conversion, deal value and revenue - but understand that great B2B sales starts with understanding the client's business,

  • are highly independent and do not need a finished sales playbook before taking action,

  • experiment, measure results and improve your approach quickly,

  • can demonstrate a concrete success story from your past where you built a sales channel or strategy from the ground up and achieved measurable results.

  • use AI, automation and modern sales tools to increase the quality and speed of your work,

  • can communicate fluently in English and Polish.

What we offer

  • ownership of the full sales process,

  • direct access to experienced product, technology, recruitment and venture-building teams,

  • the freedom to test new markets, channels and approaches,

  • flexible working hours and remote work with access to our office in Szczecin,

  • paid days off, healthcare and insurance benefits,

  • personal growth budget, a base salary plus a performance-based commission model.

Compensation

Contract b2b: Base + uncapped performance-based commission. The commission structure will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Process

Application Review - we'll review your application and experience to assess your fit for the role.

Intro Meeting (30 min with COO) - get to know each other, discuss your background and introduce you to Red Sky, the role and what we're building.
